$comment: The Trisagion in Classical Syriac (West Syriac use): the Qadishat, its short form, the Kurielaison that follows it in the Syriac liturgy (the Greek kept in Syriac letters, as the liturgical books keep it), and the Syriac doxology as a bundle-local gloriaPatri so the Byzantine form of this bundle never falls back to Latin mid-prayer. Standard Syriac Catholic wording, provisional until the Mission of St. Gamaliel sends their own (2026-08-08). Prayers are Hebrew square script; the same text in Syriac letters is in transliterations, which is what the flow's script toggle shows. Unpointed. Punctuation-free, clause per line, as the scripture files are — the comma is the print editions' habit, not the manuscripts'.
